conversation_starters.title: Minnesota weather: Twin Cities experiences 5th warmest summer on record
questions: Did this summer feel hotter and drier than usual where you are?
Has the drought changed anything about watering the yard or garden?
conversation_starters.description: Meteorological summer is over, and if you thought this summer was unusually hot and dry, you were right. It was officially the fifth-hottest summer on record for the Twin Cities metro, and also one of the driest.
